mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.brand_id, p.brand_name, p.product_category_id, pc.`name` AS product_category_name, p.feight_template_id, p.product_attribute_category_id, pac.`name` AS product_attribute_category_name, p.`name`, p.pic, p.delete_status, p.publish_status, p.price, p.original_price FROM pms_product p LEFT JOIN pms_brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id LEFT JOIN pms_product_category pc ON pc.id = p.product_category_id LEFT JOIN pms_product_attribute_category pac ON pac.id = p.product_attribute_category_id
